language_variant: Arabic; dialect and register review required
evaluation_protocol: Do not expose task metadata, info fields, or hidden split records to the agent.
hidden_test_policy: The hidden split in this development fixture is a placeholder for protected maintainer storage before public benchmark release. Do not train on it or publish its task text with score reports.

do not report hidden fixture data before lookup
